Nina (AE): Urgent POC blocker. Customer's parser throws JSONDecodeError: Extra data — tool payload has trailing plaintext. Demo in 2 hours. Can we swarm? :rotating_light:
Ravi (SE): Which model/stream settings? Any sample response?
Nina (AE): Hosted rw-infer-2.1-large, streaming=chunked, function_call=json_mode=strict. They sent sanitized snippet:
```
{\"tool_result\": \"{\\\"ticket\\\":\\\"T-303\\\",\\\"status\\\":\\\"ok\\\"}\"} FOOTER: debug=1
```
Parser fails immediately.
Tess (Eng): Likely trailing footer appended after the JSON envelope during streaming or a fallback path. Two quick mitigations: 1) client tolerant extraction (regex to grab first {} block) or 2) server-side tenant-scoped sanitizer that strips bytes after top-level JSON. I can enable opt-in sanitizer for a single tenant in ~30m.
Marta (SRE): Correlating logs: small burst of 502/429 around 2026-10-01T15:40Z for that region, retries observed and route=fallback-compat logged. Request IDs: rq_d3f1..., rq_d3f2... — pulling full traces.
AlertBot: Notice: tenant quota temporarily hit; automatic backoff applied.
Ravi (SE): Customer prefers server fix. Can we promise opt-in ETA and a sample client workaround in the meantime?
Tess (Eng): Yes: ETA ~30m for tenant flag on Hosted (short gated rollout), immediate for Dedicated. Workaround snippet for them: use regex to extract JSON blob before strict parse. I'll post the patch diff once CI completes.
Nina (AE): I'll communicate: apology, temporary client snippet, opt-in sanitizer ETA 30m, and offer credits if demo impacted. Also share SOC2 link. Anyone review before send?
Tess (Eng): I'll review the technical text. Also filing a follow-up to ensure retry fallback preserves json_mode; Marta pls include traces in the ticket.
Marta (SRE): Will do. Assignments: Tess = opt-in sanitizer + patch; Marta = traces + retry ticket; Ravi = customer comms draft; Nina = credits/SOC2. Back in 30m with status. :thumbsup:
